# AI Index (llms.txt) - Enterprise LangGraph Platform (LGP v2.0)

Ini adalah indeks struktural untuk LLM/Agent yang bekerja pada codebase LGP v2.0.

## Core Architecture
- [Overview](wiki/overview.md): High-level platform summary and components.
- [DeepAgents Integration](wiki/concepts/deepagents-integration.md): create_deep_agent orchestration, SubAgent contract conversion, bitemporal AGENTS.md injection, and filesystem sandboxing.
- [10 Subagents](wiki/concepts/10-subagents.md): Persona, scopes, and pod organization.
- [Persistence Layer](wiki/concepts/persistence-layer.md): Hybrid SQLite <-> Supabase strategy, RLS, and connection wrapping.
- [Guardrails](wiki/concepts/guardrails.md): Security, prompt injection shields, and validation.

## Memory & Telemetry
- [Memory Taxonomy](wiki/concepts/memory-taxonomy.md): Fact classification and curation rules.
- [Temporal Memory](wiki/reference/database-schema.md): Bi-temporal facts and hash-chain audit logs.
- [Correlation Matrix](wiki/reference/database-schema.md): 10x10 subagent interaction weights (NPMI, Lift, Handoff).

## Guides & Integration
- [MCP Integration](wiki/guides/mcp-integration-guide.md): FastMCP setup and tool definitions.
- [Memory Curation](wiki/guides/memory-curation-guide.md): How to seed and clean long-term memory.
- [Dashboard Guide](wiki/guides/dashboard-guide.md): Next.js observability dashboard operations.

## Technical Reference
- [Database Schema](wiki/reference/database-schema.md): Detailed table definitions and PostgreSQL/SQLite types.
- [Admin Tools](wiki/reference/api-and-mcp-tools.md): List of 17 FastMCP admin tools for system control.
